title: Adopt a repo-local lore skill: drop skill_source = plugin while opum-lore is disabled in this checkout (DEC-238 a1)
description:
Ruling DEC-238 (a1), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:47:40Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a1), verbatim: "while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a REPO-LOCAL generated SKILL.md. The 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting is left untouched, whatever its reason. A repository returns to skill_source = "plugin" only once the plugin is measured enabled in its own checkout. Each plugin-source repository with the plugin off in its checkout drops the skill_source = "plugin" line, runs `lore agents`, and confirms --check exits 0, as its own tier-2 decision, scheduled in the plan."

AMENDED BY DEC-238 (a2), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:54:02Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a2): (2) the hand-written CLAUDE.md sentence that a .claude/skills copy is drift is amended by the owner IN THE SAME CHANGE, as the owner tier-2 decision; (3) opum-quest is intended and nothing changes -- it is off at user scope by the operator first-party answer of 2026-10-12 (DEC-172 (4bf)), quest guidance reaches workers through the managed quest block pointing at `quest instructions`, no repo-local quest skill is restored (ODOC-142 retired it), and re-enabling is the operator call.

AMENDED AGAIN BY DEC-238 (a3) AND (a4), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T07:18:35Z (records: opum-ai/opum-doc#1354 merged for (a3), opum-ai/opum-doc#1355 for (a4)). (a2)(1) was UNSATISFIABLE and is retracted: the `plugin-claude disabled ... scope=user` line reports the 2026-10-20 override itself, which (a1) leaves untouched, so it stays after a correct fix. That line is EXPECTED to remain while the override stands and is NOT a failure. The criterion is now: after the change, `lore agents --check` no longer reports "absent-plugin-sourced" (where it did before) and reports the Claude skill file up-to-date; .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists; `lore agents --check` and `lore check` both exit 0.

SEQUENCING, from (a3): `lore check` is measured at this repository CI-pinned lore version, as CI runs it -- `npx @opum-ai/lore@<pinned> check`, currently 0.13.0 from ci.yml:70 -- NOT with the newer 0.14.1 local binary. WCLI-78 (the lore/quest 0.14.1 drift, open in this repository) LANDS FIRST when the plan allows; if it has not landed, the measurement is taken at 0.13.0 and the record says which version it used.

POINT 2 OF (a4): (a2)(2) covers HAND-WRITTEN prose only. A sentence inside a managed block (lore:agents or the Quest block) is corrected by regenerating that block, never by hand. MEASURED: the sentence is CLAUDE.md line 96, outside both managed blocks (Quest block lines 1-9, lore:agents block lines 11-20), so it is hand-written prose and hand-editing is the correct route. If `lore agents` still writes the plugin wording inside a managed block after skill_source stops being "plugin", that is a lore-cli template defect to FILE, not something to patch by hand.

POINT 3 OF (a4): QCLI-531, RULED A -- the quest exit code is unchanged and the output states that `state: current` covers the managed block only, not plugin enablement. Nothing changes on the quest side of this repository; recorded only because an earlier note here drew the wrong inference from that line.

BEFORE-STATE, measured in this checkout at 2026-10-25T06:50Z so the fix is proved both ways:
- `lore agents --check` exits 0 AND reports `absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` and `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user`, with the remedy `claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user`. Exit 0 is therefore already true while broken and proves nothing on its own.
- .claude/skills/ does not exist in the checkout at all.
- .lore/config.toml:36 on origin/dev reads `skill_source = "plugin"`.
- .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, mtime 2026-10-20 22:20) sets `"opum-lore@opum": false`.
- `claude plugin list`: opum-lore@opum 0.14.1, scope user, Status disabled.

AUTHORITY: this edits this repository own governing files, so applying it is a tier-2 decision -- the operator or this session, never a relayed instruction. Filing and amending the record is what was asked; the edit itself waits for the plan.

NOT TOUCHED: .claude/settings.local.json stays exactly as it is -- the ruling leaves the 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting untouched whatever its reason.

NOT STARTED: tracker-only; the fix waits for the day plan to schedule it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .lore/config.toml contains no skill_source setting, and no other live line in the repository sets skill_source = plugin for lore
lore agents has been run and a repo-local .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, generated by lore agents with no hand edits

After the change, lore agents --check no longer reports absent-plugin-sourced and reports the Claude skill file up to date, .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, and both lore agents --check and lore check exit 0
The lore check measurement records the lore version used and that version is the CI pin -- 0.14.1 after WCLI-78 -- never a newer local binary
The plugin-claude disabled line still appearing in lore agents --check is recorded as expected while the 2026-10-20 override stands, and is not scored as a failure

The hand-written CLAUDE.md profile sentence about the skills is amended in the same change, outside both managed blocks, to say the repo-local lore skill is expected while opum-lore is off in the checkout under DEC-238 (a1)
.claude/settings.local.json is unmodified and still reads "opum-lore@opum": false, and the PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity

implementationNotes: Amended per DEC-238 (a2), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:54:02Z (opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a2), ruling on the three follow-ups raised when this task was filed. Recorded the before-state measured at 2026-10-25T06:50Z so the fix is proved both ways, tightened the check criterion to the finding lines plus both exit codes, moved the CLAUDE.md sentence amendment into the same change, and closed the quest-side question as intended per DEC-172 (4bf).

Amended per DEC-238 (a3) and (a4), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T07:18:35Z (opum-doc #1354 merged for (a3), #1355 for (a4)). (a2)(1) retracted as unsatisfiable: the plugin-claude disabled line reports the untouched 2026-10-20 override and is expected to remain. Criterion rewritten to the (a3) wording; lore check is measured at the CI pin via npx, never the newer local binary; WCLI-78 lands first when the plan allows. (a4) point 2 measured against the file: CLAUDE.md line 96 sits outside both managed blocks, so hand-editing is correct and a managed-block occurrence would be a lore-cli template defect to file. (a4) point 3 closes the quest-side observation.

Correction while implementing, 2026-10-25: criterion 1 said "generated between managed markers", which was my assumption and is wrong. Measured: .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md is generated wholesale by lore agents and carries no markers of its own; the marker language belongs to the CLAUDE.md blocks. Reworded to "generated by lore agents with no hand edits". Dated the sequencing note to 0.14.1 now that WCLI-78 has landed and the CI pin and the local binary match.
